lines.en: I drift and search for food at the same time.

lines.zh: 我沿着地面绕，闻每一处。
lines.en: I sweep along the ground, checking every spot.

lines.zh: 我飞得歪歪扭扭，因为太饿了。
lines.en: I fly crooked, because I am so hungry.
My light swells and shrinks.
I duck under a bush to look.
I swing half a circle around a stone.
I drift forward; my belly rumbles.
I search from one end to the other.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根飘，那里有东西掉过。
lines.en: I hug the wall's base, where things have fallen.
I stop; my light trembles.

lines.zh: 我又转回去，怕漏了什么。
lines.en: I turn back, afraid I missed something.
I drift slowly. Out of strength.
I head for where the smell is.

lines.zh: 我绕着一棵树走了两圈。
lines.en: I go twice around a tree.
I work downward, peering at the soil.
I suddenly dart a short way.
I hover, and my light drops a notch.
I am listening to my own rumbling.
I turn one way, then back.

lines.zh: 我停下很久，什么都没找到。
lines.en: I stop a long while. Found nothing.
I slide slowly down the bark.

lines.zh: 我的光把落叶照得发白。
lines.en: My light bleaches the fallen leaves.
Hungry and sleepy, I cannot hold steady.
I stare at an empty corner.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，光散成几缕。
lines.en: I shudder; my light frays.
I drift up a little.
I seem to be dozing.
I have not left. I am simply out of strength.
I wait for someone to drop something.

lines.zh: 我的光把地上照出一小圈。
lines.en: My light makes a small circle on the ground.
I turn half a circle slowly.
I sniff the air again.

lines.zh: 我飘到你面前，停得很近。
lines.en: I drift to your face and stop very close.

lines.zh: 你的手上有东西的味道。
lines.en: Your hands smell of something.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，找你的口袋。
lines.en: I circle you, hunting your pockets.
I drift toward your pack.
I lift my head; my light flickers.

lines.zh: 你身上没有吃的，我失望了。
lines.en: No food on you. I am disappointed.
I press to your sleeve and sniff.
I settle on your hand, weightless.

lines.zh: 你又看了我一眼，我还没走。
lines.en: You look again. I have not left.
I open toward your hand.
I begin a third circle.

lines.zh: 我悬在那儿，等你摊开手掌。
lines.en: I hang there, waiting for you to open your hand.

lines.zh: 光被撞缺了一块，我晕晕的。
lines.en: A chunk of my light is knocked out and I reel.
I drift unsteadily.
I shrink a size.
I scatter into pieces and gather again.
I shake badly.
A thin whine comes from me.
I retreat under a leaf.
I flicker and almost go out.
I drop and roll once.
I slowly re-form.

lines.zh: 有吃的味道，我立刻飘过去。
lines.en: A food smell and I am there at once.

lines.zh: 那味道一飘过来，我立刻凑上去。
lines.en: The smell drifts over and I dart straight in.

lines.zh: 我把它吞下去，光抖了一下。
lines.en: I swallow it; my light jumps.
Not enough. I want more.
I press to the back of your hand, begging.

lines.zh: 我小声哼着，绕你的手指打转。
lines.en: I hum softly and circle your finger.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我就往上飘。
lines.en: You raise it; I rise after it.
I finish it in one go. Too fast.
Having eaten, I shine a little brighter.
I return in front of you and wait.
I hold it in my glow, reluctant to swallow.

lines.zh: 你把最后一小块给我了。
lines.en: You give me the last piece.
I fly two circles around you.
I am full; my light steadies.

lines.zh: 我落在你肩上，蹭了一下。
lines.en: I land on your shoulder and nuzzle.
I follow you, hoping for more.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我根本没在意。
lines.en: You bump me; I hardly care.
I wobble, but my light holds.
I press against you and sniff.

lines.zh: 我没有让开，我想看看你有没有吃的。
lines.en: I do not move. I want to see if you have food.

lines.zh: 你把我推开，我又飘回来。
lines.en: You push me away; I drift back.

lines.zh: 我的光在你衣服上留了个印。
lines.en: My light leaves a mark on your clothes.

lines.zh: 我被撞得转了半圈，接着找。
lines.en: Knocked half around, I keep searching.

lines.zh: 我从你的手臂下钻过去。
lines.en: I slip under your arm.
I have no strength to bump back.

lines.zh: 我弹开一小段，眼睛还黏着你。
lines.en: I bounce away a little, still stuck on you.
Another glow is hungry too.

lines.zh: 我们并排找吃的，谁先找到谁先吃。
lines.en: We search side by side. Finder eats first.

lines.zh: 它分了我一点，我很感激。
lines.en: It shares a little with me. I am grateful.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，光稳定了。
lines.en: We lean together; our light steadies.

lines.zh: 我们一起往有味道的地方飘。
lines.en: We drift toward the smell together.

lines.zh: 它的光比我亮，我跟在后面。
lines.en: Its light is brighter; I follow behind.

lines.zh: 我们绕着一棵树，各找一边。
lines.en: We circle a tree, one to each side.

lines.zh: 我们同时看到了一样东西。
lines.en: We spot the same thing at once.
It lets me have it.

lines.zh: 我们一起吃完，都亮了一点。
lines.en: We finish together and both brighten.
I lift it with my glow.
I swallow it in one motion.
I circle it twice before eating.
Not food. I put it down.

lines.zh: 我把它含在光里，慢慢吃。
lines.en: I keep it in my glow and eat slowly.
I cannot lift it. Too heavy.

lines.zh: 我把它推到一边，继续找。
lines.en: I shove it aside and keep searching.
It shrinks inside my glow.
I have no hands. Only my glow can carry it.
Finished, and hungry again.

lines.zh: 我盯上你手里的东西了。
lines.en: I have fixed on what is in your hand.
I drift toward you.
I make a hurried sound.
My light flares.
You back away. I still follow.
I come around to your hand.
I stop within reach.
I marked where you put it.
I circle your wrist.
I do not intend to give way.
I follow, and the gap narrows.
You switch hands; I switch sides.

lines.zh: 我在你肩头上下浮动，不肯走。
lines.en: I bob at your shoulder and refuse to leave.
Wherever you go, I drift there.
I press close to your pack.

lines.zh: 你把手放进兜里，我就停在兜外。
lines.en: You put your hand in a pocket; I hover outside it.

lines.zh: 我的光暗了一点，我有点累了。
lines.en: My light dims. I am a little tired.
I smell it again.
You can hear me humming.
I am almost within reach.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，只为了那个味道。
lines.en: I slam into you only for that smell.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手转得很快。
lines.en: I spin fast around your hand.
I press into your knuckles.
My light gives you a sting of heat.
You swat me away; I do not leave.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的护甲上，火花掉了。
lines.en: I hit your armor and sparks fall.

lines.zh: 我又扑了一次，力气不大。
lines.en: I lunge again. Not much force.

lines.zh: 我扑向你的背包带子，扯住不放。
lines.en: I dive at your pack strap and hang on.
I miss and tumble twice.
I stop before you; my light flickers.

lines.zh: 我亮起来，第一件事就是找吃的。
lines.en: I light up, and my first act is to look for food.

lines.zh: 我一出现就闻到了味道。
lines.en: The moment I appear, I smell it.

lines.zh: 我先转了半圈，看看四周。
lines.en: I turn half a circle to look around.
My light is a little weak.

lines.zh: 我朝最近的活物飘过去。
lines.en: I drift toward the nearest living thing.
I know there will be something to eat here.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，光一闪一闪。
lines.en: I stop in midair; my light flickers.

lines.zh: 我饿得连光都提不起来。
lines.en: I am too hungry to lift my own glow.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，找落下的东西。
lines.en: I keep low, looking for fallen things.
I have never been full.
The heat thins my glow.
I fall, and my light scatters all the way down.
Water closes over me; my light goes out.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹到很远的地方。
lines.en: The blast blows me far off.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我，光断了一下。
lines.en: Something passes through me and my light breaks.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的光压住。
lines.en: That force presses my light down.

lines.zh: 我本来就在饿，现在更暗了。
lines.en: I was already hungry. Now I am darker.

lines.zh: 雷光压过来，我整个麻掉。
lines.en: The lightning light bears down and I go numb.

lines.zh: 黑里连我自己都看不见了。
lines.en: In that dark I cannot even see myself.
